args:
b=
[ -n "${DEVBOARD_BIN:-}" ]&&[ -x "$DEVBOARD_BIN" ]&&[ ! -d "$DEVBOARD_BIN" ]&&b=$DEVBOARD_BIN
if [ -z "$b" ];then
for h in "${DEVBOARD_HARNESS_DIR:-}" "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)/.devboard" "$(pwd)/.devboard" "${PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR:+$PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR/..}";do
for r in bin/devboard target/release/devboard target/debug/devboard;do
[ -x "$h/$r" ]&&[ ! -d "$h/$r" ]&&{ b=$h/$r;break 2;}
done
done
fi
b=${b:-$(command -v devboard)}
[ "$b" ]||{ echo "devboard-mcp: no devboard; searched DEVBOARD_HARNESS_DIR, .devboard/bin/devboard, .devboard/target/release/devboard, .devboard/target/debug/devboard; build with 'cd .devboard && cargo build' or set DEVBOARD_BIN" >&2;exit 127;}
exec "$b" mcp
